collection.transport: One authorized ADB device; transport identifier omitted
collection.method: Read-only adb shell queries; adb exec-out cat for selected vendor configuration files. No adb root, su, reboot, fastboot, settings writes, raw block-partition reads or explicit DSI transactions.
collection.privacy: Serial, IMEI, Android ID, MAC, SSID, tokens, panelCellId and physical display unique IDs are not retained. Full getprop/settings/dumpsys responses were filtered in host memory; only the selected observations below are retained.
collection.collector_note: 06-tools/collect_readonly.sh was inspected, not executed. Equivalent bounded queries were used so unrestricted dumps and unreviewed identifiers would not be written into the workspace.
collection.empty_property_semantics: An empty getprop result means unset or unavailable to shell, not a false value.

identity.interpretation: The target reports boot hardware SKU XT2611-1 and revision pvt while Android identifies as global motorola edge 70 max / avr_g. These are software observations, not an independent physical board inspection.

matching_archive_candidate.verification: Matches the pre-OTA build W3WW36.65-64-4 only; after the 2026-10-28 OTA the unit runs W3WWS36.65-64-4-1. Archive has not been compared with target binaries. Different hardware SKU: offline reference only, not a verified backup or flash candidate.

display_manager.note: Modes are software-reported timings. In particular, cached active 120 Hz while screen OFF is not a measurement of physical refresh or PWM. The collector did not wake the screen.

settings.command: adb shell settings list <system|secure|global>; retain brightness/refresh and flicker/dimming/pwm/DC/low-light candidate keys only
settings.flicker_key_search: Case-insensitive flicker, dimm, pwm, low_light/lowlight, anti, and dc as underscore-delimited component across system, secure, global key names
settings.note: Brightness mode 1 denotes automatic brightness. Stored brightness is not optical luminance. Absence of matching Settings keys neither locates the UI switch nor proves that it is inactive. No off/on experiment was performed.

display.property_note: Numeric paneltype/sensortype values and dimming-related property names are retained as observations only; their semantics and relationship to the Flicker prevention control are unproven.

panel_identity.evidence: Installed QDCM JSON contains top-level key mipi_mot_cmd_boe_1440p_dsc_682; matching C3D filenames exist; software-reported resolution is 1440x3168. Corresponding published AVR DTS references ILI97701A variants, but live panel selection cannot be read.
